success_definition: block CoG < 20 px AND |angle| < 20 deg, checked after every step (primary)
pos_success_definition: block CoG < 20 px after any step (secondary); headline on pairs whose start CoG error >= 20 px; rotation pairs: |goal angle - start angle| >= 20 deg

cem_wm.note: upper bound: every episode uses all 40 steps

cem_wm_1step.note: upper bound: every episode uses all 40 steps

cem_pixel.note: upper bound: every episode uses all 40 steps

tau.definition: pct of ||E_wm(o_i) - E_wm(o_j)||^2 over same-val-episode frame pairs with is_success(s_i, s_j); imagined success = terminal ||z_H - z_g||^2 < tau
